entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Unfortunately, sir, the Reformists..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, sir, the Reformists appear to be as clean as a whistle. Earlier rumors about connections to oligarchs turned out to be just that: rumors."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Then you'll just have to make sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you'll just have to make sure Nia never finds out."
entries.menuText: "Then you'll just have to make sure Nia never finds out."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not only on your chances of re-ele..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only on your chances of re-election -- but on the remainder of your current term."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""However...""

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was stupid enough to order this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was stupid enough to order this investigation. I deserve what's coming to me."
entries.menuText: "I was stupid enough to order this investigation. I deserve what's coming to me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I certainly hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I certainly hope so."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Frankly, sir, I'll do what I can,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, sir, I'll do what I can, but I may not be able to protect you from the consequences of your reprehensible conduct."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's it? That's the result of a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's it? That's the result of a years-long investigation?"
entries.menuText: "That's it? That's the result of a years-long investigation?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Really? What are these people, sai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? What are these people, saints?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if we were to manufacture som..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if we were to manufacture some dirt on them?"
entries.menuText: "What if we were to manufacture some dirt on them?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Ricter o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Ricter once and for all."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Ricter once and for all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian shrugged stiffly."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian shrugged stiffly.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Nia and her Anti-Corruption police..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nia and her Anti-Corruption police would be likely to find out. In fact, you're lucky your behavior towards the party has been, well, unimpeachable."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Manoly b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Manoly before she gets any more popular."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Screw it. Let's sink Manoly before she gets any more popular."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That would put a rather abrupt end..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would put a rather abrupt end to the momentum she's been gathering and help clear the path for your re-election."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Your previous actions with Ricter..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your previous actions with Ricter have already put you on shaky moral ground, wouldn't you say?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Forming the Secret State Police al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forming the Secret State Police already put you on rather shaky moral ground, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That would help drain support from..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would help drain support from the Reformists and clear the path for your re-election."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. President, you're already abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, you're already about to neutralize one of your biggest opposition parties. Taking out both would just be wishful thinking."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You'll be happy to hear that the i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be happy to hear that the investigation into the NFP was rather more successful."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Don't worry, Mr. President. I'm su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, Mr. President. I'm sure these allegations will be easy to sweep under the rug."

entries.dialogueText: Lucian sighed.

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish. I'll give the order t..."

entries.title: Player: ""What? Lies!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Lies!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll do what I can to mitigate the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do what I can to mitigate the damage. But I can't promise there won't be consequences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze seemed to be fixed on some..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze seemed to be fixed on some faraway corner of the hotel room.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I like the way you're thinking.""
entries.dialogueText: "I like the way you're thinking."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Wouldn't it also be, you know, ill..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wouldn't it also be, you know, illegal?"
entries.menuText: "Wouldn't it also be, you know, illegal?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sorry I couldn't bring you bet..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry I couldn't bring you better news."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""So, should I give the order?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, should I give the order?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I do tend to be right on these mat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do tend to be right on these matters."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, sir."

entries.title: Player: ""What's the big deal? He's the one..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the big deal? He's the one who accepted it."
entries.menuText: "What's the big deal? He's the one who accepted it."

entries.dialogueText: "As you wish. I'll give the order to the new police chief."
